name: Cryonic-Dolina
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws a binary sunset, patient as erosion itself.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The ore-body estimates keep being revised upward, which keeps the gun-runner schedules full.
